description: A blank 4HP panel with no controls and no jacks, for filling a gap in the rack
notes: a new panel comes up as Absolute Night when Rack's View menu has Use dark panels if available ticked, and as Creamy when it does not; after that the choice is fixed until you change it
the first three finishes come with silver screws and the last three with gold
menu: Model: Creamy, Stage Repro, Absolute Night, Dark "Signature", Deepblue "Signature", Titanium "Signature" — chooses the panel finish, which is the whole point of a blank panel
